narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with Hormuz blockade persisting and US military assets engaged. The market consensus underestimates the structural disruption, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and short S&P 500 futures; overweight gold and USD.

narratives.title: Energy Supply Chain Disruption
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy assets as the Hormuz blockade structurally tightens oil supply through Q3 2026, with SPR releases signaling bullish pre-positioning rather than bearish intervention. Pipeline bypass discussions and elevated EIA forecasts confirm persistent supply risk.
narratives.trade_implication: Long crude oil futures and energy sector ETFs; short refined product spreads.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Mirage vs. Reality
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing a fragile status quo despite White House claims of Iran deal progress, as military readiness and actual strikes contradict diplomatic narratives. The disconnect between official statements and on-ground escalation creates volatility, with markets gradually repricing risk.
narratives.trade_implication: Long VIX futures and short emerging market bonds; hedge with gold options.
